items.title: Initial Establishment
items.desc: On Jan 31, 2023, at 4:25 PM, Gudupao Studio (predecessor of Gudupao Spark Inc.) was established in Huadu, Guangzhou, founded by a group of middle school students who loved playing Minecraft

items.title: New Name, New Logo
items.desc: In Mar 2023, the new name Gudupao Spark Studio was born (second phase Mar-Jul), along with a new logo

items.title: Reorganization After Internal Split
items.desc: The remaining members formed a new studio continuing as Gudupao Spark Studio (third phase)

items.title: Period of Uncertainty
items.desc: During this time, the studio lacked clear development goals (fourth phase Aug to Nov 2023, also known as the uncertainty phase)

items.title: Beginning of Independent Development
items.desc: Proposed the Xianyu Analysis Project, began the period of independent algorithm software development, established feasible phase goals, and continued development. The studio officially entered its fifth phase (Dec 2023 to present)

items.title: Xianyu Analysis Release
items.desc: Xianyu Analysis was released after two months of effort by three members of Gudupao Studio. The promotional video premiered on Bilibili (B-site), marking the success of Gudupao Spark Studio's independent development path!!!

items.title: Studio's First Anniversary
items.desc: After a year of challenges, the studio celebrated its first anniversary. Throughout this year, the studio experienced difficult times and periods of uncertainty. We picked up and lit our torch in the vast snow, and we will illuminate our own future ahead.
